prompt: Write an Amber HTTP::Handler that resolves an account subdomain and scopes call_next to its row tenant.
completion:
require "grant"

require "amber"

require "http/server"

class RequestTenantAccount < Grant::Base
  table requesttenant_accounts

  column id : Int64, primary: true
  column subdomain : String
end

module RequestTenant
  class ResolveRowTenantFromSubdomain
    include HTTP::Handler

    def call(context : HTTP::Server::Context)
      host = context.request.headers["Host"]?.try(&.split(":", 2).first)
      subdomain = host.try { |value| value.split(".").first if value.count(".") >= 2 }

      unless subdomain && (account = RequestTenantAccount.find_by(subdomain: subdomain))
        context.response.respond_with_status(:not_found)
        return
      end

      Grant::Tenant.with(account.id) { call_next(context) }
    end
  end
end

Amber::Server.configure do
  pipeline :web do
    plug RequestTenant::ResolveRowTenantFromSubdomain.new
  end
end

request.headers["Host"] = "acme.example.test"
context = HTTP::Server::Context.new(request, HTTP::Server::Response.new(IO::Memory.new))
RequestTenant::ResolveRowTenantFromSubdomain.new.call(context)
